en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a cobblestoned market square with a circular fountain in the foreground and a row of 2–3 storey townhouses with shops, inns, and signage in German along the ground floor. A horse-drawn carriage is visible at the left and another near an archway on the right. At the bottom in red print it reads "Königsbrück. Marktplatz." and publishing information dated 1906.
